headings.rationale: Clean, professional, and confident font for a financial SaaS application without looking generic.

body.rationale: Highly legible, especially for numbers and tabular data which is critical for cash flow apps.

rules: NEVER use generic #000000 or #808080. Use Slate/Charcoal shades.
No full-screen gradients. Use flat solid colors.
Always set hover text colors explicitly.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border (E2E8F0). Sharp or slightly rounded corners (max-rounded-md).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Avoid soft diffuse shadows. Use crisp 1px borders instead.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-px), border color darkens, slight shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for all iconography. Keep stroke width 1.5 or 2.

grids_and_layout.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6 for tight data density.
grids_and_layout.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layout.kpi_cards: col-span-1. F-Pattern layout. Top row: Key Metrics. Middle: Charts. Bottom: Data tables.
grids_and_layout.alignment: Numbers right-aligned in tables, labels left-aligned. Optical alignment over geometric.

components_strategy.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn/UI Select, Input, Checkbox. Dense styling.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn/UI Table. Alternating row colors or simple border-b. Sticky headers if possible.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts. Use clean lines, no heavy gradients. Tooltips must be fast.
components_strategy.modals: Shadcn/UI Dialog for Add Expense, Add Check, Add Promissory Note.
components_strategy.tabs: Shadcn/UI Tabs for filtering (e.g., Received vs Issued Checks, Monthly vs Yearly). Override fixed heights.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle transition on background color for list items (transition-colors duration-200).
motion_and_interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders for data tables rather than spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over colored badges (green/red) has >= 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='add-expense-button', data-testid='export-csv-button').

avatar.description: Professional smiling man for user profile avatar

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Do NOT apply universal transition: all.
Use 2-3x more spacing. Ensure data tables have enough breathing room.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Make sure the UI is in Turkish as requested by the user.
Ensure the Excel/CSV export functionality is visibly accessible (usually a button top right of tables).
